comments.author: Rashid
comments.body:
Here's the official answer

To complete any memorial album

1.You can find an item (collection,search,procurement etc.) But it CANNOT be another player's item that u find
2.You can craft a required item.
3.You can buy an item ONLY from the market or NPC item shops. Company shop, bazaar,delivery DON'T WORK
4.The items can be obtained via plundering ONLY from a NPC and NOT another player.
5.Can be given an item ONLY by the NPC not from another player.
6.Items can be found in dungeons HOWEVER if you are in a fleet and they get an item it will count for THAT 1 person and NOT the whole fleet.
